title: Round hay bales two-high on a farm trailer (side)
blurb: A tractor towing a flatbed stacked two-high with round hay bales at a rural junction, blue straps over the bales.
photo_credit: Photo: Bill Boaden, CC BY-SA 2.0 via Geograph / Wikimedia Commons. QA sweep development run, Oct 26, 2026.

calibration.axis: x (front at bed_min_x, rear at bed_max_x)
calibration.method: pixels-per-inch = trailer_bed mask bitmap tight extent along x (2044 px) / user-supplied bed length (16.0 ft = 192 in)

measurements.name: rear_overhang
measurements.method: rearmost cargo extent (mask bitmap tight edge, else bbox) minus the bed rear edge, scaled by the calibration; rear = image-right end of the bed extent

measurements.name: load_centroid_vs_axle
measurements.method: bitmap-weighted centroid of all cargo masks along the bed axis vs the axle estimate position (midpoint of axle centres when several), scaled by the calibration; positive offset = centroid behind the axle
measurements.confidence_basis: cargo det-0025-ff0f89 conf 0.71; cargo det-0026-05cf54 conf 0.73; cargo det-0027-0c355b conf 0.58; cargo det-0028-7164d7 conf 0.59; cargo det-0029-b00d95 conf 0.57; cargo det-0030-c5c029 conf 0.74; cargo det-0031-df93ee conf 0.57; cargo det-0032-3f9a81 conf 0.60; cargo det-0033-26378c conf 0.61; axle_estimate axle-0034-3b62c0 conf 0.89

uncertainty.basis: one bitmap-weighted standard deviation of the cargo pixels along the bed axis (the load's own spread), floored at 2 in; a photo shows where the bulk sits, not how heavy it is

measurements.name: tarp_coverage
measurements.method: tarp/canvas mask area overlapping the cargo area, as a percentage of the cargo area (bitmap union on the image canvas)
measurements.reason: load type is 'hay', not loose material; the tarp check only applies to loose loads

measurements.name: tiedown_coverage_gaps
measurements.method: tie-down anchor positions mapped onto the bed axis (anchor centre x in bed coordinates); spans between neighbouring anchors and the bed ends, scaled by the calibration
measurements.reason: no tie-down detections in this detection set: tie-downs are counted from anchor close-up photos plus tap-to-correct, and close-up coordinates live in the close-up photo's own image space, so they cannot be placed on this photo's bed axis

notes: load_centroid_vs_axle is a visual estimate of where the load's bulk sits; it is not a weight measurement

verdicts.finding: The load can slide forward: its front edge is 60.6 in behind the front of the bed with nothing shown blocking it. Under hard braking that gap is how far the load can surge.
verdicts.minimum_fix: Block the front of the load: shift it forward against the headboard or bulkhead, or place secured blocking so the open gap is under 6 in.
verdicts.confidence_basis: front gap derived deterministically from the Day 2 calibration (bed front edge, pixels-per-inch) and the frontmost cargo extent (cargo det-0029-b00d95)

cross_check.spark_view: Spark's read of the side photo: load does not appear blocked at the front

verdicts.fix: Block the front of the load: shift it forward against the headboard or bulkhead, or place secured blocking so the open gap is under 6 in.

verdicts.finding: This load needs 3 tie-down(s) for its length (16 ft), but no tie-downs could be counted: tie-downs are counted from anchor close-up photos plus any you mark by tapping them on the photo, and neither was supplied. Full-frame photos cannot count straps reliably (they are too thin to read at that distance).
verdicts.confidence_basis: no close-up detection set and no user tie-down marks supplied

verdicts.cfr_citation: 49 CFR Part 393, Subpart I (overhang; lights and plate visibility)
verdicts.finding: Overhang: the load ends at or inside the rear of the bed (0 in overhang). Lights and plate: not checked (needs the rear photo read by the cross-check; segmentation cannot judge whether lights or the plate are obscured).
verdicts.citation: 49 CFR Part 393, Subpart I (overhang; lights and plate visibility)

verdicts.cfr_citation: 49 CFR 393.100 (load placement; visual estimate only here)
verdicts.finding: Photo estimate puts the load's bulk 49.2 in behind the axle, more than the +/-34.0 in uncertainty of the estimate: the load reads rear-heavy, which unloads the tongue and can make the trailer sway. This is a visual estimate of where the bulk sits, not a weight measurement.
verdicts.minimum_fix: Shift the load forward so its bulk sits over or ahead of the axle, then recheck with a new photo.
verdicts.confidence_basis: cargo det-0025-ff0f89 conf 0.71; cargo det-0026-05cf54 conf 0.73; cargo det-0027-0c355b conf 0.58; cargo det-0028-7164d7 conf 0.59; cargo det-0029-b00d95 conf 0.57; cargo det-0030-c5c029 conf 0.74; cargo det-0031-df93ee conf 0.57; cargo det-0032-3f9a81 conf 0.60; cargo det-0033-26378c conf 0.61; axle_estimate axle-0034-3b62c0 conf 0.89; visual estimate only

cross_check.spark_view: Spark's read of the side photo: load does not look rear-heavy
cross_check.sam_view: centroid estimate verdict: CHECK_THIS (visual estimate only)

verdicts.citation: 49 CFR 393.100 (load placement; visual estimate only here)
verdicts.fix: Shift the load forward so its bulk sits over or ahead of the axle, then recheck with a new photo.

verdicts.finding: Tarp coverage cannot be checked: load type is 'hay', not loose material; the tarp check only applies to loose loads.

Edge protection cannot be judged from the evidence supplied: it needs a close-up of each strap where it crosses an edge, read for protectors. Take an anchor close-up per tie-down and run the cross-check.
verdicts.confidence_basis: no close-up cross-check evidence about straps over edges

verdicts.finding: Tie-down strength cannot be checked from the photo: a photo cannot verify working load limit ratings or load weight, and this check needs both numbers. Missing: no tie-down working load limit ratings were supplied; no load weight was supplied. Supply the load weight and each tie-down's rating and this check runs on those numbers.
verdicts.confidence_basis: not computable: no tie-down working load limit ratings were supplied; no load weight was supplied

report.headline: Load can slide forward and sits rear heavy
report.body:
Front blocking needs checking. Load front is 60.6 in behind bed front with nothing blocking it. Shift it forward against headboard or bulkhead, or add secured blocking for gap under 6 in.
Weight placement needs checking. Bulk is 49.2 in behind axle, beyond 34.0 in uncertainty, so it reads rear heavy. Shift bulk over or ahead of axle, then recheck with new photo.
Tie-down count could not be told. Needs 3 for 16 ft but none counted. Needed are anchor close-ups or marks on photo.
Overhang is 0 in. Lights and plate could not be told. Needed is rear photo read by cross-check.
Tarp coverage could not be told. Load is hay, not loose material, which the check requires.
Edge protection could not be told. Needed are close-ups where each strap crosses edge plus cross-check.
Strength could not be told. Needed are working load limit ratings and load weight.
A photo cannot verify strap tension, tie-down ratings, or load weight.
